newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine president forecasts growth in 1998, 1999.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine president forecasts growth in 1998, 1999.

text.p: Ukraine could achieve economic growth of four percent in 1998 and six percent in 1999 if it continues with its economic reform programme, President Leonid Kuchma said during his annual address to the country on Friday.
"This is a very real possibility," Kuchma told his government and parliamentary deputies.
Ukraine has forecast zero growth this year, after a drop in gross domestic product (gdp) of 10 percent in 1996.
